Diagnostics and Troubleshooting

MelonUI reports build-time generator errors, MXML compilation errors and runtime UI errors separately. This page explains where to find those errors and some common causes.

MXML Compilation Errors

  • CompilerMessages: All messages produced by the last compilation.
  • CompilerFocusedMessage: The current result, including the source path and XML line/column.
  • CompilationFinished: The elapsed compilation time.
  • MXML / MXMLFilePath: The last successfully compiled document. A failed edit does not replace these.

GetSimpleCompilerDisplay formats the messages without writing to the console.

Common Problems

ProblemThings to Check
Content is blank or overlappingCheck X/Y, Height, visibility and the content space left by borders. Pages do not automatically stack children.
A labeled TextBox has no input rowUse Height="5" or larger when a border is shown.
A grid cell is out of rangeRegister a GridContainer factory with the intended constructor row and column counts.
A generated property is missingCheck that the field is mutable, its class is partial, and the analyzer is referenced by that project.
A bound value does not updateCheck the public property path, backend alias, notifications and any caching/polling requirements.
An included file cannot be foundSupply sourcePath or CompilerOptions.BaseDirectory. Includes are relative to the file containing them.
Changing an attached control throwsQueue the change with Post or InvokeAsync while RunAsync is active. Stop producers during shutdown.
RunAsync requires an interactive terminalAvoid redirected input/output, or use CaptureText for headless rendering.
FilePicker still shows the previous filterCall Refresh after changing Extensions.
OpenGL initialization failsCall Init on the application main thread before awaiting RunAsync, and check graphics support.

Runtime Errors

Compile returns false for expected markup errors. Once the page is running, failures in callbacks or bindings use the normal runtime error handling.

InvokeAsync faults its returned task. Unexpected posted, keyboard and frame/update errors reach UnhandledException and otherwise fault RunAsync after terminal cleanup. Only set Handled=true if the application can safely continue.
